versos.texto_bv: Ele governava sobre todos os reis, desde o rio até a terra dos filisteus e até a fronteira do Egito.
versos.traducao_literal: E era governante sobre todos os reis, desde o rio e até a terra dos filisteus e até a fronteira do Egito.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): 'o rio', sem identificação explícita do Eufrates, pode gerar ambiguidade referencial ao leitor pt-BR contemporâneo. — evidência: NTLH, ARA e NVIPT nomeiam explicitamente 'o rio Eufrates'/'o Eufrates'. A traducao_literal pinada mantém apenas 'o rio' (idiomatismo hebraico הַנָּהָר, epíteto padrão do Eufrates). Adicionar 'Eufrates' seria uma especificação referencial que ultrapassa a forma e exigiria decisão de conteúdo/tradução (alterar a traducao_literal), fora do escopo desta revisão editorial de forma. Texto mantido inalterado.

kjv.texto: And he reigned over all the kings from the river even unto the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.

vizinhos.25: And Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen; whom he bestowed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.
vizinhos.27: And the king made silver in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the low plains in abundance.

web.texto: He ruled over all the kings from the River even to the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.

vizinhos.25: Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, that he stationed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.
vizinhos.27: The king made silver to be in Jerusalem as stones, and he made cedars to be as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland, for abundance.
